description: Checks a piece of writing for the habits that make people think a chatbot wrote it (em dashes, words like "delve", assistant filler like "I hope this helps", "it's not X, it's Y", fake suspense, stiff transitions, markdown leftovers, emoji bullets, rule of three, same-length sentences). Returns a 0-100 bot-o-meter score, a verdict and the tells found. Style habits only. Not an AI detector and not proof of who wrote the text.

text.description: The writing to check (up to 60,000 characters).

name: tells_score_text
title: Score writing for AI-sounding habits
